# UnnecessaryIssetArguments

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Unused](/rules/#unused) · PhpStorm name: `UnnecessaryIssetArgumentsInspection`

`isset($m['a']['b'])` already implies that `$m` and `$m['a']` are set, so
listing those containers as extra `isset()` arguments next to the deeper
access is redundant. Drop them.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{4,5,7} [Before]
<?php
function has_city(array $order, $customer)
{
    $a = isset($order, $order['ship']['city']);
    $b = isset($order['ship']['city'], $order['ship']);
    $c = isset(
        $customer->tags,
        $customer->tags[0],
        $customer
    );
    $d = isset($order['ship'], $order['ship']);
    $e = isset($order['bill']['zip'], $order['ship']);
    $f = isset($order);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function has_city(array $order, $customer)
{
    $a = isset($order['ship']['city']);
    $b = isset($order['ship']['city']);
    $c = isset(
        $customer->tags[0],
        $customer
    );
    $d = isset($order['ship'], $order['ship']);
    $e = isset($order['bill']['zip'], $order['ship']);
    $f = isset($order);
    return [$a, $b, $c, $d, $e, $f];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 4: Redundant isset() argument: a deeper array access already covers it.</li>
<li>line 5: Redundant isset() argument: a deeper array access already covers it.</li>
<li>line 7: Redundant isset() argument: a deeper array access already covers it.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "UnnecessaryIssetArguments": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore UnnecessaryIssetArguments

/**
 * @noinspection UnnecessaryIssetArgumentsInspection
 */
```
